name: Unhandled Exception
source:
You follow the story from the perspective of Zac, a college student with a deep sentiment for the old games he used to play. There’s also his roommate, Randal, blessed with the charm of a resting bitch face - as well as Villow… who’s quite the exception to the bunch.
